discription: A simple pulse wave synth with a resonant low-pass filter and vibrato.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, pan=0, detune=0.002, vibratoRate=5, vibratoDepth=0.01; var sig, env, filterEnv, lfo; env = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2 ); lfo = SinOsc.kr(vibratoRate) * vibratoDepth * freq; sig = Pulse.ar([freq, freq * (1 + detune)]) * 0.5; filterEnv = EnvGen.ar( Env.adsr(0.01, 0.3, 0.5, 0.5, curve: -4), gate: gate ); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, freq * 4 + (freq * 8 * filterEnv), rq ); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan));}
